messages:
Sophia: Quick sync 1: drafted a compact battlecard focused on three buyer moments: cost-ops, reliability, and compliance. dropped in the doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1yNewExample
Ben: skimmed. strong start. can we make the competitor callouts 1-line each? sales wants something they can read in 10s.
Anya: did that. short rep lines in doc: cloud platforms = "easy to start, hard to predict cost"; LLM APIs = "broad model access, limited infra guarantees"; infra vendors = "you run it, we help tune it". open to edits.
Mike: Webinar idea: 20m demo + 20m customer fireside. Demo shows live cost calculator switching between hosted/dedicated/private. customer panel talks rollback stories and SLOs. CTA: book a dedicated consult or request trial capacity.
Claudia: inbound routing summary: post-webinar flows to an intake form with qualifiers (ARR, compliance, latency needs). low-fit => nurture sequence; mid-fit => SDR + SE; enterprise => AE + Solutions Eng. I'll add a flowchart to appendix.
Sophia: add a canned objection handler for "we have on-prem GPUs": "you can keep models where you want; Redwood unifies serving policies, SLOs, and observability so teams avoid building ops glue". short and sales-friendly.
Ben: Messaging tweak: prefer "predictable inference economics" over plain "cost savings". sounds less transactional and implies reliability.
Anya: added that line. also included micro-benchmark table: hosted/dedicated/private with median latency and cost per token (rounded). meant for discovery calls only.
Mike: For infra vendors: short playline: "If you want to own the stack and hire ops, great. If you want predictable SLAs + dev speed, Redwood wins." keep it convo-friendly.
Claudia: Sales enablement asks: include three discovery q's: 1) "What are your 95th percentile latency targets?" 2) "How stable is your monthly inference spend?" 3) "Have you tested model rollback in production?"
Sophia: Adding SE whisper notes: if they mention multi-region, call out dedicated + auto-fallback region routing as a quick win. Also include canary rollback script in appendix.
Ben: Can we include 3 email subject options for post-webinar follow-up? simple, clear.
Mike: Drafting 8-min demo script now. will show live switch to cached replies if GPU pool congested. dry-run needed 48h before webinar.
Anya: I'll finalize the objection handlers and add a 6-item FAQ. keep answers <2 sentences.
Claudia: Routing doc will include playbook triggers and SLA thresholds. attaching it in 30m.
LaunchBot: Task created: finalize-battlecard-playbook assigned to Sophia due: 1765320000
Sophia: thanks everyone. plan: merge the battlecard beta into enablement repo by Friday EOD and schedule a sales office hours session next week. :rocket:
